description: This file defines the DebugReceiver class, a BroadcastReceiver that logs Bluetooth-related intents and their extras for debugging purposes in an Android Bluetooth application.

classes.name: DebugReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver implementation that logs Bluetooth intents and their extras for debugging.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles received broadcast intents, logging the action and extras.

methods.name: shorten
methods.description: Converts long intent action or extra strings to a shortened form for cleaner logging.
